title: Software Development Tutor
company: NTID Learning Center - Rochester Institute of Technology
summary: Provide individualized and group tutoring on programming concepts across Python, Java, and Excel. Adapt teaching approaches to diverse learning styles using ASL and spoken communication to support Deaf and hard-of-hearing students, while reinforcing computational thinking and debugging strategies.

title: Data Science Intern
company: Artificial Intelligence and Biomedical Informatics and Data Science (AIBIDS) Program - University of Pittsburgh
summary: Collaborated with faculty and peers on data-driven healthcare and informatics research, combining SQL, LLMs, and statistical modeling to study what predicts unplanned surgery after ACL reconstruction.
highlights: Surfaced risk patterns in 5,000+ de-identified patient records to inform a predictive model for unplanned surgery.
Extracted 464 pre-surgery clinical notes from a UPMC ACLR database (2013-2021) using SQL CTEs, joins, and embeddings.
Classified activity levels with an LLM (DeepSeek-R1 14B), reaching 0.89 F1 on elite athletes via 6 hand-annotated example batches.
Built logistic regression models in scikit-learn to predict unplanned surgery from social determinants of health (SDoH).
Presented a research poster on activity level as an SDoH predictor to faculty, peers, and stakeholders.
